about_the_game:
Build your own characters! The TIME ELEMENTS series is all about modular pieces, letting you build unique RPG sprites with ease. Swap outfits, hairstyles, armor, weapons, and now: animal heads, tails, and more! The characters are fully animated, bringing your gameplay to life with four-directional action combat in a high-quality pixel art style inspired by your favorite RPG classics.

With Time Elements Character Expansion 2, unleash your creativity with new modular pieces, including animal features and quirky accessories, to populate your game world with unforgettable characters!


Contents:

⦁ Fully compatible with the Time Elements Character Core Set and Expansion 1
⦁ Build your own sprites with the Character Generator!
⦁ Over 30 unique pieces, with color variants, including animal heads, tails, new weapons, hairstyles, hats, and body types.
⦁ Animated fishing pole item for fishing in all four directions!
⦁ Animations in all four directions: walk, crouch, jump, attack, and others
⦁ Includes extras from the original release, including the 27-page PDF guide, so you can dive in without needing the core set



Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
